# Escort directional atlas

Generated with built-in `image_gen` on 2026-09-25 using `bazaar-escort-v2.png` as identity/style reference. The original transparent output is saved as `bazaar-escort-directions-v1.png`; its JSON atlas selects 12 frames, without altering source pixels. Rows: Mados, Iria, messenger. Columns: down/front, right, left, up/back.

Both chapters load the shared `bazaarEscortDirections` texture. The shared `ui/escort-sprites.js` helper picks directions from actual sprite displacement, keeps idle facing, maintains body height and foot anchor, and handles both position updates and tweens. Mados is 74 px; Iria and the messenger are 70 px.

## Final prompt

Use case: style-transfer. Input image is the identity and style reference for three compact THREE-HEAD-TALL pixel-art JRPG characters. Create ONE transparent production DIRECTIONAL sprite atlas: exactly 3 rows by 4 columns, 12 full-body sprites. Row 1 is Mados (short dark hair, beard, broad build, navy gold-trim coat, leather belt and sheathed sword). Row 2 is Iria (dark high ponytail, sage green jacket, cream scarf, satchel and brown boots). Row 3 is the messenger (auburn short hair, mustard vest, rust trousers, leather satchel, white sealed letter). EVERY row shows same character in FOUR different directions in this exact column order: column 1 FRONT facing viewer/down, column 2 RIGHT PROFILE facing screen right, column 3 LEFT PROFILE facing screen left, column 4 BACK facing away/up. True side profiles and true backs, NOT four front poses. On back views show back of hair, back of coat and satchel strap, no visible face. Preserve reference proportions (large head, short body and short legs) and clothing colors and details. Same full standing height for all cells, feet aligned within each row, arms and legs in neutral standing pose. Crisp chunky 16-bit pixel art, subtle overhead RPG camera angle. Canvas 1536 wide by 1536 high, exactly equal 384x512 cells. Keep each sprite well inside its own cell, with ample transparent margin on every side so they do not touch cell edges. Genuine transparent ALPHA background, no checkerboard, no background colors, no glows, no shadows. No text or grid lines. Entire body including boots in every cell. It is essential that columns 2 and 3 look in opposite horizontal directions, and column 4 shows backs.
